title: Structural metadata and gate reconciliation
summary: Reconcile every path-bearing metadata/gate/doc carrier after package moves while proving public namespaces unchanged.
why: `@plan/knowledge/research-P16-design.json` §12; code can pass local tests while CI, PHPStan, graph allowlists or split paths still point to old files.

exclude: New public namespaces, broad allowlist, behavior/DDL, per-package changelogs and hand-edited generated manifests.
